data.name: Basheera
data.gender_notes: Basheera is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'Basheer', meaning 'good news' or 'happy, joyful, radiant'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that Basheera is a name for a girl who brings happiness and joy to those around her. The name Basheera carries the meaning “Happy, Joyful, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Basheera usually hope their child will grow to embody happy, joyful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A woman who radiates positivity and brings joy to those around her.
data.etymology: Basheera belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Happy, Joyful, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basheera total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
